name: FS-9 "Stoneface" LMG
description: Behring designed the FS-9 to be an overwhelming battlefield force. This light machine gun features a full auto mode that makes it ideal for laying down covering fire or holding back advancing enemies. The FS-9 is also acclaimed for its ability to maintain accuracy while unleashing sustained fire. This entry in the Legendary Bounty Hunters line had famed tracker Farook 'Stoneface' Norris design a look for his beloved FS-9 LMG featuring striking pops of red against a grey base tint.
